items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: The name 'Dick Allen' is mentioned by the interviewer as a label for the recording session or a participant, but the interviewee (Louis Barbarin) does not mention Dick Allen, nor does he describe any personal or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: I'm going to put the microphone right here and hopefully it doesn't pick up too much of the fan noise. You all need a fan? Don't cut it out. Maybe we can cut it out. I'll take it off. Cut it out. Pick up. Yeah. Pick up that squeak in there.

Okay, I'll put my name. Dick Allen. Bill? This is Bill Russell. Ralph Collins. Okay. All right. I think that's a good introduction there. Everybody knows which voice it is on the tape when they hear it.

Do you want to start out when you were born? Just anything you have your notes there if you want to follow that would be fine. You want to, when you're ready? Yeah. I learned how to play the drums. Right?
